item.description: Equinix started construction of SL4, its fourth Seoul IBX, with a 20 MW first phase due in 2027.

item.title: Incheon to host 300 MW hyperscale campus, Example Data Centers says
item.description: Example Data Centers today announced a 300 MW hyperscale campus in Incheon, with the first 60 MW phase scheduled to reach ready-for-service in the fourth quarter of 2028. The company said the site has secured a grid connection agreement with the utility and will use direct-to-chip liquid cooling for AI workloads, with a design PUE below 1.2. Construction financing is being arranged with a consortium of Korean lenders, and anchor tenant discussions are under way with two hyperscale cloud providers.

item.title: Samsung SDS to build AI data center in Gumi
item.description: Samsung SDS said on Sunday it will build an AI data center in Gumi, North Gyeongsang Province, to host GPU clusters for enterprise customers. The facility is planned at 40 MW of IT load in its first phase and is expected to open in 2028, the company said in a regulatory filing.
